title: Day 5/28 - Terraform Variables - Input vs Output vs Local Variables
description:
Welcome to 5/28 day of Terraform Full Course For Beginners
In this video, we will deep dive into Terraform variable management 🚀

In just 20 minutes, you'll learn: ⭐️ 
- The REAL difference between input, output & local variables (no more confusion!)
- How to make your code 10x cleaner using .tfvars files
- The simplest approach to understand variable precedence in Terraform

The best part? I will show you practical examples in Azure that you can start using TODAY.

💡 Quick tip: Understanding variables is like learning to organize your room - once you get it, everything flows!
